history_summary.value: An old Polish breed identified by its unusual green legs, first described in 1879 and officially recognised in 1923; it was once raised across roughly 70 percent of Poland but declined sharply once it failed to adapt to intensive farming. It was used between 1946 and 1954 to help create the autosexing Polbar breed, and today survives only in two small closed conservation flocks.
